title: SCD Type 2 Point-in-Time Join
hints: This is a range join: match the dimension version whose validity window contains the order date.
Half-open windows: valid_from <= order_date AND order_date < valid_to. The current version has valid_to = NULL, so OR valid_to IS NULL.
LEFT JOIN from the fact table so orders with no matching version (before the first version, or unknown customer) still appear with a NULL tier.
